opening.text: I've been feeling tired all over and I've been itching, which is actually quite severe. It all started about 2 months ago. I've noticed the whites of my eyes have turned yellow, and I have a lot of scratch marks on my body, arms and legs. I was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago and I use mesalamine rectally.
